title: oenanthe lachenalii subsp. silaifolia
intro: Oenanthe lachenalii subsp. silaifolia, commonly known as Water Dragon, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Water Dragon are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the gut-brain axis, promote relaxation, and alleviate stress. The bioactive constituents of Oenanthe lachenalii subsp. silaifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
